friendly_name: Felix Foundation-0 Exec-Hardening — Finding & Doc Reconcile
purpose_context: Foundation 0 proved the Felix/OpenClaw capability boundary is prompt-convention only. Steps 1-2 (memory-core kill, skill-scoping) shipped, so gog now survives on main + calendar. Step 3's intended hard containment via per-agent exec allowlists was found infeasible during design research: the workers use general-purpose exec (inline eval, heredocs, redirection, curl, scratch scripts), so an allowlist strict enough to block gog would break their real jobs. This mission banks the unconditional wins instead — records that finding (recommending sandbox as the real hard-containment lever), reconciles the architecture docs to live config, documents main as the tracked exception (#680), and files a sandbox follow-up. It makes no openclaw.json change.
purpose_tldr: Record that per-agent exec allowlists cannot hard-contain gog without breaking Felix's workers (sandbox is the real lever), reconcile the architecture docs to live config, and file the sandbox follow-up — no openclaw.json change.
